rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: At its first meeting on the 5th the leader election headquarters set the schedule: notice 27 September 2013, filing the same day 10:00-15:00, voting 12-13 October, count 14 October.

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
